events.text: The source confirms the primary defect: the physical ply arrays are expanded to six layers for `LAM='SYM'`, but the referenced-material list remains the three stored half-laminate entries; `zip(...)` silently stops after three layers. The same routine also halves the classical `B` integral a second time and documents—but does not apply—the angle offset, so I’m repairing the integration path as a whole rather than only extending one list.
